results.title: A path towards sanity, by Patrick Omorodion
results.content: Whatever has a beginning must have an end, is a popular saying. On Friday, October 23, 2026, members of the Lagos State chapter of the Sports Writers Association of Nigeria (Lagos SWAN) took a bold step to begin the sanitisation of their troubled association, which has been held down by a self-inflicted crisis. Yes, I say self-inflicted because they allowed their ranks to be infiltrated by persons who are neither journalists nor practising sports writers. Never in the history of SWAN, since it was founded in 1964, has the Lagos chapter been embroiled in such impunity and an alleged hijack by one individual. And I know that the founding father, Babatunde Oshuntolu, popularly known by his pen name, Esbee, would turn in his grave if he heard what has become of the once-vibrant association.
